items.title: Why the Market Changed Its Closing Time
items.topic: a local market testing an earlier closing time on quiet weekdays
items.action: compared customer numbers, staff hours, and electricity use before and after the change
items.benefit: workers finished earlier and the market reduced costs during hours with few customers
items.challenge: some residents depended on late shopping after work
items.lesson: an efficient change should be judged by who benefits and who loses access
items.detail: the market kept one late evening each week after reading customer comments
items.reflection: Maya learned that a compromise can preserve most savings without ignoring an important minority
items.titleJa: 市場が閉店時間を変えた理由
items.topicJa: 平日の静かな日に閉店を早める地域市場の試み
items.benefitJa: 利用者が少ない時間の費用を減らし従業員も早く帰れること
items.challengeJa: 仕事後の遅い時間に買い物する住民もいること
items.lessonJa: 効率化は利益だけでなく利用できなくなる人も考えて評価すべき

items.title: The School's Reusable Cup Trial
items.topic: a school cafe replacing disposable cups with reusable ones
items.action: tracked how many cups were returned, washed, and lost during a month
items.benefit: the cafe threw away far fewer single-use cups
items.challenge: washing required water, energy, staff time, and a reliable return system
items.lesson: an environmental choice should be evaluated across its whole process rather than by one visible result
items.detail: students tested a small deposit that increased the return rate
items.reflection: Noah discovered that reducing waste depends on behavior as much as on the object itself
items.titleJa: 学校のリユースカップ実験
items.topicJa: 使い捨てカップを再利用カップに替える学校カフェの試み
items.benefitJa: 使い捨てごみを大幅に減らせること
items.challengeJa: 洗浄には水やエネルギー、作業時間、返却の仕組みが必要なこと
items.lessonJa: 環境への効果は目立つ一面だけでなく全体の工程で考える必要がある

items.title: A Town Listens Before Building
items.topic: a town asking residents how an empty lot should be used
items.action: helped summarize surveys about a playground, garden, parking area, and open field
items.benefit: officials learned which needs mattered to different groups before spending money
items.challenge: the most popular option was not necessarily the most useful for every neighborhood
items.lesson: public decisions improve when numbers are combined with reasons and local context
items.detail: the survey included written comments instead of only multiple-choice answers
items.reflection: Ari learned that counting preferences is only the beginning of understanding them
items.titleJa: 建設前に住民の声を聞く町
items.topicJa: 空き地の使い方について住民に意見を聞く町
items.benefitJa: 費用を使う前に異なる住民の必要を把握できること
items.challengeJa: 最も人気の案がすべての地域に最も役立つとは限らないこと
items.lessonJa: 数字に理由と地域事情を組み合わせると公共の判断は良くなる

items.title: When a Club Removed Its Ranking Board
items.topic: a sports club testing whether public rankings motivated young players
items.action: compared attendance and practice effort before and after rankings were hidden
items.benefit: some beginners became more willing to participate and make mistakes
items.challenge: several experienced players missed the clear goal that rankings had provided
items.lesson: the same motivational tool can affect people differently depending on experience and confidence
items.detail: coaches replaced the board with personal progress goals
items.reflection: Emi saw that motivation is stronger when feedback matches what a learner needs
items.titleJa: 順位表を外したクラブ
items.topicJa: 公開順位が若い選手の意欲に与える影響を試したスポーツクラブ
items.benefitJa: 初心者が失敗を恐れず参加しやすくなったこと
items.challengeJa: 経験者の中には順位という明確な目標を失った人もいたこと
items.lessonJa: 同じ動機づけでも経験や自信によって効果は異なる
